why: RJ-P51, pending FH-6 (suiteui/fill-heal): the catalog has no fill.bucket until FH-6 builds RetouchCommands, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. Opens logo.png (48 x 32, flat white, a navy disc of radius 10 at 24, 16 with a 4 x 4 supersampled anti-aliased edge), fills from (4, 4) at tolerance 32, contiguous, red, and exports a PNG. The trap: the fill bleeds into the anti-aliased edge or misses the corners.
